from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from tools.rolling_production_queue import validate_prepared,no_calling
from tools.production_window_gate import inspect_window
old='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v37';new='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v38'
folder=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production';state=read_json(folder/(old+'.json'))
assert state['status']=='stopped_at_safe_boundary' and state['completed_source_requests']==state['completed_windows']==55
assert state['machine_id']==machine_id() and not (folder/'owner.json').exists() and (folder/(old+'-released-owner.json')).exists()
assert not (folder/(new+'.json')).exists();no_calling(ROOT)
gate=inspect_window(ROOT,state['after_window'],machine_id());assert gate['ready'],gate
phase=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v37-phase.json')
assert phase['current_tag'] is None and phase['completed_groups']==20
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches']
for item in plan[state['next_index']:]:validate_prepared(ROOT,item)
events=[e for p in (ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings').glob(old+'-window*-completed.json') for e in read_json(p)['events'] if e['phase']=='image_resolved']
counts={'calls':len(events),'PNG_returns':sum(not e.get('error') for e in events),'errors':sum(bool(e.get('error')) for e in events)}
assert counts['calls']==55 and counts['PNG_returns']+counts['errors']==55
spec={'runId':new,'startIndex':state['next_index'],'afterWindow':state['after_window'],'maxCalls':64,'maxPreviewBytes':6553600,'maxRunSeconds':14400}
specp=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v38-spec-20261028.json';assert not specp.exists();write_json(specp,spec)
source=ROOT/'docs/handoffs/2026-10-28-low-v37-helper-sources.json'
frozen=ROOT/'docs/handoffs/2026-10-28-low-v38-helper-sources.json';assert not frozen.exists()
body=read_json(source);body.update(frozen_before_new_owner_claim_at_utc=utc_now(),unchanged_from={'path':source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(source)})
write_json(frozen,body);assert read_json(frozen)['sources']==read_json(source)['sources']
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261028-low-v38.json';assert not target.exists()
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'prepared_at_utc':utc_now(),'previous_actual_state':state,
 'previous_actual_call_results':counts,'previous_last_window_gate':gate,'spec':spec,
 'helper_sources':frozen.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'helper_sources_sha256':file_sha256(frozen),
 'remaining_prepared_windows':len(plan)-state['next_index'],'free_bytes_observed':shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free,
 'image_calls':0,'retention_review_utc_unchanged':'2026-10-29T10:30:00Z',
 'scope':'Actual builtin cell1918 collected at terminal safe boundary after55 calls; original owner released. New finite continuation uses byte-identical tested helpers with fresh4h/64-call/32-review-group bounds, without extending old bounds or replaying any image call. Root b260 final matte and2 approvals/2 rejections were staged after original V37 cutoff and await next sole-producer boundary.',
 'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
s=(ROOT/'runtime/start-root-review-v37-20261028-template.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8').replace('v36','OLD_VERSION').replace('v37','v38').replace('OLD_VERSION','v37')
s=s.replace("old['completed_groups']==9","old['completed_groups']==20").replace('previous calls10','previous calls55').replace("'previous_root_groups':9","'previous_root_groups':20")
t=ROOT/'runtime/start-root-review-v38-20261028-template.py';assert not t.exists();compile(s,str(t),'exec');t.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
s=(ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v37-actual-invocation-20261028.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8').replace('v37','v38')
t=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v38-actual-invocation-20261028.js';assert not t.exists();t.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
end=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261028-v37-finite-phase-end.json';assert not end.exists()
write_json(end,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'actual_builtin_cell':'1918',
